title: Korean-Style Pork Belly Ssam
description: A modern twist on traditional Korean BBQ, this dish features tender pork belly wrapped in a crispy, spicy ssam wrap.

ingredients.name: Pork belly
ingredients.notes: Score the fat in a diamond pattern

ingredients.name: Luxurious soy sauce
ingredients.notes: Use a high-end soy sauce for added depth

instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, gochujang, brown sugar, and garlic.
Place the pork belly in a large ziplock bag and pour the marinade over it. Seal the bag and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Remove the pork from the marinade and place it on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the pork in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until caramelized and crispy.
While the pork is cooking, prepare the ssam wrap by cutting it into thin strips.
To assemble the ssam, place a few pieces of the roasted pork onto a ssam wrap, followed by a sprinkle of chopped green onions and crispy garlic.
